headlines.headline: Section 301 Becomes Law: Federal Register Publishes 10–12.5% Duties on 60 Economies
headlines.driver: For XLI: Positive implementation — 345-page notice codifies TRQs that determine XLI's sector hit dispersion; machinery and autos in 22 sectors now have clear cost, allowing XLI firms to re-price contracts.

headlines.headline: Chip Industry Braces for 70% Stack — 50% IP + 12.5% Forced Labor + Pending 7.5% Overcapacity
headlines.driver: For XLI: Positive for XLI's automation/robotics exposure — 70% stack justifies on-shore chip/automation capex that flows to XLI's industrials, offsetting higher input costs.
